name: Floodlit
description: A football match under floodlights, seen from high in the stand: the crowd is the spectrum going round the ground, each block standing and lifting its colours with its own part while a wave runs round on the music's clock; the boards along the touchline show the spectrum as bars, cameras flash with the high notes, and two teams of eleven shift about a ball passed in arcs across a fully marked, striped pitch, each player with the four shadows of the floodlights.
